sources.title: HMAGLOFDB — glacial lake outburst flood database for the Hindu Kush Himalaya
sources.scope: Himalayan-wide GLOF event catalog; not an India-only adjudicated cohort
sources.access_terms: CC BY 4.0 (RDS canonical record); attribution required
sources.retrieval_instructions: Request/download the v1.3.0 record from the RDS dataset page; pin retrieved bytes by SHA-256 in a successor register entry before row-level reconciliation

limitations: Reported counts are pinned to each product's own scope and vintage and are not independent event counts

No source bytes are retained by this registry; official URLs, versions, and terms are pinned for the next approved ingestion step
No lake is classified as a verified non-event from absence in a catalog
